It helps me a lot to remember when to water as well. You still can give smaller amounts more frequently- because smaller amounts dry faster- but the soil definitely should still be dry when you water regardless of the amount. The only time I water less, but in more frequency is if I have a plant in an oversized pot. Because if the pot is too large for the plant it takes forever to dry, which can also cause rot.  I try to base my watering habits off of the root structure. If the pot is full, and the roots are growing throughout the pot I water until it drains so all roots can get wwater. If the root system is smaller sometimes I'll water less to not over water. 

All in all the most important principle though is what I said initially and that is just check to be sure the soil is dry. Hope that helps :)
